description: This file implements the ClientController class and related functions for managing client connections, shared memory, and application state notifications within the Rialto client component. It includes methods for registering/unregistering clients, initializing and terminating shared memory, and notifying clients of state changes.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Implements the control logic for managing client connections, shared memory, and application state within the Rialto client.

classes.name: IClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Interface providing access to the singleton instance of ClientController.

classes.name: ClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Implementation of IClientControllerAccessor providing singleton access.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: ClientController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClientController, setting up IPC and registering the client.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and retrieves the current application state.

methods.name: initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory by obtaining a handle from IPC.

methods.name: termSharedMemory
methods.description: Terminates shared memory by resetting the handle.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies clients of a change in application state, managing shared memory accordingly.

methods.name: changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Updates the current application state and notifies all registered clients.
